title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring and support for SUSE MicroOS (RKE2)
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Customers running SUSE MicroOS as their host OS have reported difficulties bootstrapping the on-prem/offline installer due to differences in packaging (rpm vs deb), systemd service file locations, and rke2 bundle layout. This PR adds vendor support and offline bundle artifacts for SUSE MicroOS (rke2 distributions), updates vendoring scripts to include rpm repositories and TUF metadata for rpm-based bundles, and fixes Helm chart hooks that were failing during air-gapped upgrades. Scope: 1) Add a new distribution target 'suse-microos' to the offline bundle generator and vendor manifest. 2) Vendor rke2 and required rpm packages into the offline bundle with TUF signing metadata. 3) Extend the installer preflight to detect MicroOS and adjust kubelet/systemd unit paths. 4) Update helm chart templates and pre/post-upgrade hooks to handle package installation ordering on rpm-based systems. 5) Small Terraform module tweaks to support alternate image registries and an optional 'rpm_mirror' input. 6) Add CI job (airgap-vendor-rpm) that validates bundle integrity and performs an install test in a MicroOS VM image. The description below summarizes the notable changes and rationale. Backwards compatibility: The generated bundles remain compatible with existing deb/apt targets; existing ubuntu/flatcar/k3s bundles are unchanged. The installer now has a distro-detection code path and chooses rpm vs apt flows at runtime. Testing: - Local validation: bundle sanity checks, TUF verification, and install smoke tests in qemu MicroOS image. - End-to-end: staged rollout to our internal lab (perf-canary) validated upgrades from previous onprem releases and rollback behavior for failed post-install hooks. Rollout plan: merged to main and will be cherry-picked to release/2025.11 for customers on the 2025.11 onprem channel. Related: SUP-3221 (customer report), ENG-1448 (airgap vendoring work), ENG-1511 (rke2 distro support).

release_notes: Add support for SUSE MicroOS (RKE2) in offline installer bundles: vendoring of rke2 rpm packages, TUF metadata for rpm bundles, installer distro detection and rpm install path, Helm hook fixes for rpm flows, new terraform 'rpm_mirror' option, and CI job to validate rpm airgap bundles.
